home.title: ArGeles — Artisan jellies, made to order
home.description: Hand-moulded jellies decorated with fresh fruit, made for the date of your celebration. Choose your piece and order it on WhatsApp.

links.title: ArGeles — Links
links.description: Message us on WhatsApp, visit the website or download the PDF price list.

hero.headline: Delicacy in every layer
hero.body: Hand-moulded and finished with fresh fruit. Each piece is made for the date of your celebration: weddings, christenings, birthdays and dessert tables.

orders.statement: Orders are scheduled one week in advance

section.title: The menu
section.subtitle: Every piece is made to order with selected fresh fruit. Choose yours and order it on WhatsApp.

hints.layers: Pick the layers — each extra layer adds {{price}}

frutas-en-capa-cristalina.name: Fruit in a Crystal Layer
frutas-en-capa-cristalina.note: Strawberries, peach and grapes in clear jelly
frutas-en-capa-cristalina.description: Strawberries, peach and grapes suspended in clear jelly, over a base of tres leches jelly.
frutas-en-capa-cristalina.imageAlt: Clear jelly crown with strawberries, purple grapes, peach and green grapes

fresa-a-franjas.name: Strawberry Stripes
fresa-a-franjas.note: Sliced strawberry over strawberry, lime and tres leches stripes
fresa-a-franjas.description: Sliced strawberry over fine stripes of strawberry jelly, lime jelly and tres leches jelly.
fresa-a-franjas.imageAlt: Rectangular jelly with red, white and green layers, sliced strawberries on top

anillo-de-cereza-y-tres-leches.name: Cherry and Tres Leches Ring
anillo-de-cereza-y-tres-leches.note: Cherry and tres leches, alternating, in a ring mould
anillo-de-cereza-y-tres-leches.description: Cherry jelly and tres leches jelly alternating in a ring mould.
anillo-de-cereza-y-tres-leches.imageAlt: Flower-mould jelly, red on top and cream below, on a gold board

uva-a-dos-tonos.name: Two-Tone Grape
uva-a-dos-tonos.note: Grape jelly in two tones, crowned with fresh grapes
uva-a-dos-tonos.description: Grape jelly in two tones, one dark layer and one with condensed milk, crowned with fresh grapes.
uva-a-dos-tonos.imageAlt: Fluted jelly mould, dark purple over a lilac layer, with grapes at the centre

fresa-con-cubitos.name: Strawberry with Cubes
fresa-con-cubitos.note: Fresh strawberry cubes over strawberry and condensed-milk stripes
fresa-con-cubitos.description: Fresh strawberry cubes in the top layer over stripes of strawberry jelly with condensed milk.
fresa-con-cubitos.imageAlt: Round scalloped pink jelly with strawberry cubes in its clear top layer

cereza-y-leche-condensada.name: Cherry and Condensed Milk
cereza-y-leche-condensada.note: Cherry in two layers, one clear and one creamy
cereza-y-leche-condensada.description: Cherry jelly in two layers: one clear, and a creamy base with condensed milk.
cereza-y-leche-condensada.imageAlt: Red jelly in a round pearl mould on a white plate

fresa-en-envase-individual.name: Strawberry in an Individual Cup
fresa-en-envase-individual.note: Creamy strawberry base, strawberry cubes and a jelly flower
fresa-en-envase-individual.description: A creamy strawberry jelly base, fresh strawberry cubes and a jelly flower. Ready to serve: each 200 ml cup comes with its lid and spoon.
fresa-en-envase-individual.imageAlt: Lidded individual cups of strawberry jelly with fruit cubes and a pink flower on top
